name: Single-serve shakshuka with spinach & pumpkin seeds + 2 Angel PRO pitas (him only)

source.author: Personal single-serve version, designed with the user
source.notes: Omer's own single-serve meal (not for Lihi). Built from cherry_tomato_shakshuka_high_protein, scaled to one person: 4 whole eggs (no egg whites), ~350 g cherry tomatoes (~1½ baskets, ~25-30 tomatoes — they cook down 40-50%), 1 tsp olive oil, garlic, chili, a handful of spinach (~50 g), 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds on top, no red pepper, no cheese. Eaten with 2 Angel PRO pitas as the whole meal. Pita values are from the label: Angel PRO pita, 8 units / 500 g (62.5 g each), per 100 g = 201 kcal, 20.6 g protein, 22.7 g carb, 5.9 g fibre, 1.9 g fat, 289 mg sodium. NOTE: per the label, Angel's PRO pita is whole-grain WHEAT (31% whole-wheat flour) with soy/chickpea/pea protein — not spelt. Contains gluten; vegan. Salt taken as a pinch. Estimate.

serving_desc: the whole meal: 1 pan (4 eggs) + 2 Angel PRO pitas

ingredients.note: up to ~500 g for a saucier pan

steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a nonstick pan and cook the cherry tomatoes on medium-high until they blister and burst; press some to make a sauce.
Add the garlic, chili and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts; season lightly.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on low until set.
Scatter the pumpkin seeds on top and eat with 2 warmed Angel PRO pitas.

batch_totals.note: One complete meal. The pan alone is ~478 kcal / ~33.5 g protein; the 2 PRO pitas add ~251 kcal / ~25.8 g protein / ~7.4 g fibre — far more protein than regular pitas, which is why the meal reaches ~59 g.

him.verdict: An excellent single meal for your goals: ~59 g protein and ~14 g fibre for ~729 kcal (~8.1 g protein per 100 kcal), very filling. The PRO pitas do a lot of the work — about 26 g protein for the pair. It also hits several sperm-priority micros at once: lycopene from cooked tomatoes (absorbed better with a little oil), zinc from pumpkin seeds + eggs, selenium from eggs, folate from spinach. It's a full main meal — ~729 kcal fits as the biggest meal of a ~2,050 kcal day.
flags: ~59 g protein + ~14 g fibre for ~729 kcal (~8.1 g/100 kcal)
lycopene, zinc, selenium, folate, vitamin C in one meal
a large meal — treat it as the day's main meal
suggested_mods: Going up to ~500 g tomatoes adds volume for ~25 kcal
On a lighter day, use 1 pita instead of 2 (−~126 kcal, −~13 g protein)

her_preconception.verdict: Designed for Omer only — Lihi won't eat it in these proportions. If she ever does: cook the yolks fully set. Not scored as a dish for her.

safety_advisories.note: Runny yolks carry a salmonella risk in pregnancy.

adopted_note: Adopted 2026-11-16 as Omer's personal single-serve meal (not for Lihi). Whole meal: ~729 kcal, 59.2 g protein, 50.1 g carb, 32.4 g fat, 13.7 g fibre, ~906 mg sodium. him 9. Standing spec: 4 whole eggs, ~350 g cherry tomatoes, 1 tsp olive oil, garlic, chili, ~50 g spinach, 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds, no cheese / no red pepper / no egg whites, with 2 Angel PRO pitas (whole-grain wheat, not spelt).
cooking_guide: With just 1 tsp oil, use a nonstick pan on medium-high so the tomatoes blister instead of stewing; press some with a spoon once soft.
Add garlic after the tomatoes start to burst so it doesn't burn, then the spinach until just wilted.
Make 4 wells, slide the eggs in from a small cup, lower the heat and cover until set.
Add the pumpkin seeds at the end so they stay crunchy.
Warm the pitas in a dry pan or toaster for 30-60 seconds — they're for dipping into the sauce.
